sources.snippet: What is all-MiniLM-L6-v2? all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact sentence embedding model from Sentence Transformers designed to generate meaningful vector representations of text. It is mainly used for semantic search, information retrieval, and clustering by comparing embedding similarities across sentences or documents.
